organic.default_action: Remove non-organic parts and place the organic component in the organic stream
organic.reason: Organic material is routed separately to support composting or biological processing

recyclable_dry.default_action: Keep the recyclable component clean and dry before placing it in dry recycling
recyclable_dry.reason: Clean material has a better chance of remaining usable in the recyclable stream
recyclable_dry.contamination_action: Do not place the contaminated component in dry recycling; use the residual route unless local washing is available

e_waste.default_action: Send to the designated e-waste collection point and do not mix with general bins
e_waste.reason: Electronic items require specialized collection and downstream processing

battery.default_action: Place in the dedicated battery collection box
battery.reason: Batteries require controlled collection to reduce fire and leakage risks

hazardous.default_action: Isolate the item and use the designated hazardous-waste collection procedure
hazardous.reason: Potentially hazardous residues should not enter ordinary waste streams

sanitary.default_action: Place in the designated sanitary or residual waste stream
sanitary.reason: Used sanitary materials are generally not suitable for dry recycling

residual.default_action: Use the residual stream when the material cannot be safely routed to another local stream
residual.reason: Residual routing is used as a fallback where recycling requirements are not met

manual_review.default_action: Do not guess a disposal category; check verified local guidance or ask campus waste staff
manual_review.reason: The material is not covered by the configured policy routes
